summary: Modular synth you build inside one machine: nodes (oscillators, wavetable and sample sources, noise, envelopes, LFOs, filters, shapers, delays, mixers, math) wired together, up to 128 per patch, with 16 voices of polyphony that each run their own copy of the patch and global nodes that run once. Notes come from patterns, MIDI and MPE; sixteen macros move any node setting. Use it for sounds the fixed-architecture synths cannot make: your own FM routings, filter feedback, per-note modulation, a global delay after the voice sum.
use_for: Sounds the fixed synths cannot make: build your own routing from oscillators, envelopes, LFOs, filters, shapers and delays, with per-note and global modulation, MPE and sixteen macros.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: Output level
parameters.how: Sets the machine's output level, from -40 dB up to +6 dB or silence, after the patch's Out node.
parameters.sound: It scales the whole sound; a safety limiter after it keeps the peaks under full scale, so loud settings saturate softly instead of clipping.

parameters.name: Voices
parameters.description: Notes that sound at once
parameters.how: Sets how many notes can sound at once, from 1 to 16; each runs its own copy of every per-voice node in the patch.
parameters.sound: More voices allow bigger chords and long tails but cost more CPU; too few cut off held notes.

parameters.name: Glide
parameters.description: Glide time
parameters.how: Sets how long the pitch takes to slide from one note to the next, from 0 to 2 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short glides sound smooth, long ones swoop like a sliding synth lead; 0 plays each note at its own pitch at once.

parameters.name: Audio-rate mod
parameters.description: Control inputs at audio rate
parameters.how: Switch on to read the control inputs (cutoff, level and similar) for every sample instead of every 16 samples with smoothing.
parameters.sound: Off is cheap and smooth; On lets an oscillator frequency-modulate a filter's cutoff, giving metallic filter FM, at a higher CPU cost.

parameters.name: Macro 1
parameters.description: Macro 1, moves every node setting mapped to it
parameters.how: Moves every node setting that the patch maps to macro 1, each between its own low and high value.
parameters.sound: What it does depends on the patch; the preset's mappings are named in its description.

imports.description: A patch as one line of text (what the machine saves with the song): "neopatch 1;n 1 Keys ...;w ...". It replaces the machine's patch; the parameters stay as they are.
A WAV sample (mono or stereo, up to 20 s, kept in the machine state). Sample nodes whose Source is "user" play it.
